curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the estate's master turns up dead, cryptic clues hidden within Neville's landscape drawings begin pointing directly toward the killer.
curatedMovie.description: Hired to sketch an English country estate, draftsman R. Neville agrees to an illicit contract with the owner's wife, only for a sudden murder to turn his detailed drawings into evidence.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, witty, and suspenseful period mystery best suited for attentive solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Peter Greenaway blends period elegance with dry comedy and intricate suspense, turning 17th-century landscape art into a deadly intellectual puzzle.
